title: Prospector Pete
build: Mastertronic cassette, Novaload N103131, from the TOSEC raw tape (2016-11-11)

tools.emulator: plus4emu 1.2.11 (git 939e652) with kit/c16/codemap.patch, built without libsndfile, in the kit's server

accuracy.note: the three bytes of the beside table after earth_beside_base described
every routine ported and checked against the game's code, alone and in lockstep; the one comment it showed wrong is listed in port/corrections.md

exclude: runtime: nothing of the game is loaded below $1000. Zero page, which the start-up at $1800 clears and the game uses for its variables; the stack; the KERNAL's vectors at $0314-$0315, which the game points at its interrupts; the water list at $0200, the large goodies' list at $0316 and the dynamite list at $0700, built by start_level and place_goodies; the moving figures' shifted frames at $0400-$06FF, built by build_figures; and the leftovers of the Novaload loader in pages 1 to 3
runtime: the screen, its colours at $0800 and characters at $0C00. At the hand-over they hold the Novaload loader's screen; title and start_level fill both before anything of the game shows
runtime: characters $6D and $6E, Pete standing, blank as loaded; start_level copies them from $1500 for every level and death moves them down
runtime: character $A2, the explosion, which irq_play rewrites from the timers every frame
runtime: characters $AE-$B5, the title's frame, blank as loaded; irq_title builds them from character $A4 every other frame

runtime: rows 3 to 22 of the map, the mine, which start_level fills with earth, goodies, the shaft, the walls and the floor for every level; as loaded they hold what was in memory when the game was saved
extra: characters $80-$FF of the 256-character set at $1000: the goodies, the title's lines, the figures' frames and the alphabet
